headline: Newmont Shares Add 21.5% This Month: Can The Gold-Driven Rally Continue? - The Bull
summary: Newmont shares on the ASX added 21.5% so far in August, heading into the open at A$163.99. The move follows strength in gold prices and the broader mining sector.
why: Newmont is one of the world's largest gold miners, so its share price tracks gold prices and the profitability of mining operations.
